Jaguars vs Ravens DraftKings Showdown Picks: Thursday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Thursday Night Football, November 5 · NFL Week 9 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 4, 9:02 PM ET

Trevor Lawrence has the highest SPAGS projection in the Jaguars at Ravens DraftKings Showdown: 17.8 points at $10,600 FLEX, 26.8 at captain for $15,900. Across 10,000 simulations Lawrence holds 74% of the winning-lineup credit. The case against Lawrence is his range, not his role: a simulated floor of 5.8 points at a $10,600 FLEX salary, in a game with a 39.5-point total.

Bhayshul Tuten has the largest captain share: 20.7% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Tuten at captain. The model gives him 16.2 carries and 2.1 targets. Trevor Lawrence is the next captain in line, at 20.2%. The model has him running 3.6 times.

Jacksonville is a 10-point favorite, and the implied totals are 24.75 for the Jaguars and 14.75 for the Ravens. Neither number describes a shootout. Both describe a game where somebody has to carry the ball.

Behind Lawrence and Tuten, the next projections are Parker Washington (13.8, $9,400), Derrick Henry (12.7, $10,200) and Zay Flowers (10.9, $10,400).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 4, 9:02 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 10,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

TNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Bhayshul Tuten, JAX RB ($9,800 FLEX / $14,700 CPT)

Bhayshul Tuten holds 20.7% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $14,700 and the 16.0-point SPAGS model projection becomes 24.1 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 16.2 carries and 2.1 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Tuten averaged 16.1 points with a simulated floor of 5.1 and a ceiling of 34.4. He holds 61% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 20.7% as the captain and 40.5% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Trevor Lawrence, JAX QB ($10,600 FLEX / $15,900 CPT)

Trevor Lawrence holds 20.2% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $15,900 and the 17.8-point SPAGS model projection becomes 26.8 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 3.6 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Lawrence averaged 17.9 points with a simulated floor of 5.8 and a ceiling of 36.1. He holds 74% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 20.2% as the captain and 53.5% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Parker Washington, JAX WR ($9,400 FLEX / $14,100 CPT)

Parker Washington holds 16.1% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $14,100 and the 13.8-point SPAGS model projection becomes 20.7 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 6.1 targets on 22.7 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Washington averaged 13.8 points with a simulated floor of 1.5 and a ceiling of 39.3. He holds 44% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 16.1% as the captain and 28.2% in a FLEX spot.

Across 10,000 simulations Hill averaged 7.2 points with a simulated floor of 2.1 and a ceiling of 15.4. He holds 27% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 1.6% as the captain and 25.6% in a FLEX spot.

Chris Rodriguez Jr. projects for 6.5 DraftKings points at a $3,400 FLEX salary, 1.92 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 7.2 carries and 0.7 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Rodriguez averaged 6.5 points with a simulated floor of 1.8 and a ceiling of 14.4. Jaguars vs Ravens DraftKings Showdown FAQ

Who is the best captain for the Jaguars vs Ravens DraftKings Showdown?

Bhayshul Tuten holds the largest captain share of simulated winning lineups at 20.7%, ahead of Trevor Lawrence (20.2%) and Parker Washington (16.1%), across 10,000 simulations.

What is the best DraftKings Showdown lineup for Jaguars vs Ravens?

Build around Parker Washington at captain with Trevor Lawrence, Bhayshul Tuten and Cam Little at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (20 of 10,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $10,100 for the last two FLEX spots.

Who has the highest projection in Jaguars vs Ravens DraftKings Showdown?

Trevor Lawrence leads the SPAGS model at 17.8 DraftKings points for $10,600 at FLEX, or 26.8 points at captain for $15,900.

What are the DraftKings salaries for Jaguars vs Ravens Showdown?

Trevor Lawrence is the most expensive player at $10,600 FLEX and $15,900 at captain. All 31 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

What are the best value plays in Jaguars vs Ravens DraftKings Showdown?

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Justice Hill (7.2 points at $3,200), Chris Rodriguez Jr. (6.5 points at $3,400) and Ravens (4.6 points at $3,000).

What is the Jaguars vs Ravens spread and total?

The Jaguars are a 10-point favorite in a game totaled at 39.5, with implied team totals of 24.75 for the Jaguars and 14.75 for the Ravens.
